messages:
jamie_cs: FYI — ClinicWave sent an addendum this morning. They already signed the BAA, but the addendum asks for HSM-backed KMS (FIPS 140-2 L3), 7-year immutable audit log retention, and direct export to their S3. They're also hitting intermittent API 504s and some auth failures since ~02:00 UTC. Need triage. @alex_okoro @maria_privsec @billing_jun

alex_okoro: On it. Can you paste a few error IDs and a minimal repro? Which environment is this (hosted/dedicated/private)?

jamie_cs: Prod hosted. Error IDs: err-CLW-9812, err-CLW-9817. Repro is a long chat payload with streaming disabled — sample curl below.

jamie_cs: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"gpt-3o","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<very long clinical note>"}],"stream":false}'
```

alex_okoro: Got the IDs, seeing proxy 504 spikes right around 02:03 UTC. My guess: KV cache evictions causing model nodes to block on cold KV loads. Can you try a smaller payload to confirm? Also what SDK version?

jamie_cs: Client v2.8.1. Smaller payload seems to succeed. Full payload fails consistently.

maria_privsec: Re: addendum — we can support BYOK with HSM but full customer-controlled HSM custody requires Private/Dedicated deployment. For hosted we offer envelope keys + our KMS; not sufficient if customer insists on sole control. About "immutable" logs: we can provide append-only exports and use S3 Object Lock + retention, and provide signed manifests, but legal needs to vet the exact clause.

jamie_cs: They explicitly requested proof that logs are "immutable" and deletion cannot occur from our side.

maria_privsec: Action: I will draft an options doc: (1) Private VPC + customer HSM (recommended), (2) Hosted + envelope keys + export to customer S3 with Object Lock + write-once pattern, (3) Dedicated with customer KMS via Cloud HSM. Also include a checklist for audit manifest delivery.

sre_oncall: Immediate mitigation for 504s: increased replica count for clinicwave-production pool, raised per-request timeout to 60s for their org, and enabled prefix caching for active chat sessions. Monitoring in place.

jamie_cs: Seeing latency improve after scaling. Thanks. Any idea on the auth failures?

alex_okoro: Auth failures look like token TTL mismatch after a KMS key rotation — some long-lived client tokens were signed with the old key and rejected post-rotation. We rolled back the rotation and pushed a patch to prevent abrupt invalidation; advised customer to refresh tokens.

billing_jun: Customer also flagged a billing discrepancy: they were billed for dedicated hours for a short burst when they thought they were on hosted. I've paused invoicing for the disputed interval and opened a billing case.

security_bot: ALERT: audit-export-failure clinicwave-prod at 2026-03-17T02:05:13Z — S3 write returned 403 AccessDenied for bucket clinicwave-logs-export.

maria_privsec: Likely S3 ACL/IAM role issue on their side. I'll send the exact export role ARN and an S3 Object Lock + bucket policy checklist they must apply. Also will draft language for the addendum about export guarantees and retention enforcement.

alex_okoro: Next steps (short):
1) jamie_cs — share full repro payload + request ids and the curl shown above to the incident ticket.
2) sre_oncall — confirm scaling holds and watch 504/error rate for 2 hours.
3) maria_privsec — prepare KMS/HSM options doc + addendum redline for legal.
4) billing_jun — keep invoices paused until addendum resolution.

jamie_cs: Created incident INC-2026-CLW-12 and shared initial mitigation note with customer. I'll DM updates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
